[[File:MakemTe_TheTract.jpg|thumb|right|upright|Stela made up the Tract of Makem Te.]]
'''Stela''' were monuments to [[Death/Legends|deceased]] individuals, which together made up the vast [[Tract of Makem Te]]. Each stela was placed on a two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] square of shiny stone that abutted the neighboring tiles. Each such monument was thought by the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to house the spirit of the deceased.
